Alias of an Android-installed client certificate. The MDM must grant Sippy access to its private key, or the user must select the certificate.

Named SIP accounts registered simultaneously. Each account needs a unique stable ID and name. Enable Enter extension credentials in app to let users fill credentials while supplied server settings stay locked. Users may select any account; managed account settings are locked. Device media, codecs and listening ports use shared settings.
When supplied, force DND on or off for accounts with Show DND enabled. Omit this value to let users control each account toggle.

When enabled, users enter and edit the username/extension, authentication ID and password for this account in Sippy. These three policy fields are ignored even if the MDM console sends empty defaults. Other supplied account settings remain managed.
